provenance.description: Rockford Election Day polling places and absentee drop boxes, by precinct, with the clerk's office -- which is where an absentee ballot goes when no drop box is listed.
provenance.source: Kent County Clerk / Register of Deeds, Drop Box & Polling Locations
provenance.archive_note: The Wayback Machine holds no capture of this page. Nothing was submitted: this is one of thirty pages read per run.
provenance.licence: Public record of Kent County, redistributed as published.
provenance.how_to_update: Run refresh_polling.py. Polling places change every election, and MCL 168.662 settles them 60 days out, so re-run after that date for each election.
provenance.not_geocoded: The browser geocodes these against the street chunk it already loaded, so no coordinate here can go stale.
provenance.drop_boxes_source: Drop boxes for this jurisdiction come from the state, not from the county page, which publishes none. See `source` on each box. Re-run merge_foia_dropboxes.py after refresh_polling.py to restore them.

clerk.address: 7 S Monroe Street NE, Rockford, MI 49341

drop_boxes.name: Rockford drop box
drop_boxes.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
